name: GRID OMNI RESILIENCE CONTRACT
principles: A single asset, world, database partition, or monitoring failure must not blank the entire client.
Transient services must fail closed and degrade locally instead of blocking rendering.
Persistent player/world state must be versioned, exportable, and recoverable.
Assets require stable IDs, provenance, versioning, and a fallback representation.
Authoritative economy, combat, permissions, and inventory operations must be server-validated.
Worlds must be partitionable so one overloaded region cannot become a grid-wide outage.
Health monitoring must observe imagery, routes, runtime errors, WebGL state, performance, security, and code integrity.
Build integrity checks must fail before deployment when internal routes or local assets are broken.
Security headers belong at the delivery edge; CSP is added only after browser-console validation.
New systems must be disableable or degradable without taking unrelated world systems offline.
